description: The app's alerts, as its panel shows them: what needs the developer now (store full with its 7-day countdown, their own database not answering, payments waiting for it, a data migration paused for the quota, quota out or in its 10 % margin, users saving in a loop, formal legal notices on community entries, the community put on hold by Neblla, data erasure requests, reviews without an answer, a "Pasar a pro" batch that failed, automatic recharges done or failed) and the history (90 days). Each alert says in plain words what happens (`text.what`), what the users notice (`text.users`) and what to do or who has to look at it (`text.todo`); `urgent` ones go by email to the owner by default. action "list" { lang?, topic?, history? } → { attention, history, counts }; "dismiss" { id } (or { all: true }) marks seen; "settings" → per alert type who gets it (`to`: "owner" or team emails, from neblla_team) and where (`via`: "email", "slack", "discord"; the panel always has it), and whether a Slack / Discord webhook is set; "set_settings" { types?: { [type]: { to?, via? } | null }, slack?: url | null, discord?: url | null } (in the act); "test" { via, to? } sends a test message. Alerts that already had their own email (store full, legal notice, community hold, automatic recharge) still email the owner whatever is chosen.

discord.description: set_settings: a Discord webhook URL (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…), null forgets it

history.description: list: false leaves the old ones out

lang.description: list: language of the texts (en, es, fr, de, it, pt, ja, ko, zh, ar); English by default

slack.description: set_settings: a Slack incoming webhook URL (https://hooks.slack.com/services/…), null forgets it

to.description: test with email: "owner" or a team member's email

topic.description: list: only one page's (data, database, plan, moderation, community, inbox, gallery, publish)

types.description: set_settings: { store_full: { to: ["owner", "ana@studio.com"], via: ["email", "slack"] }, review_unanswered: null }

name: neblla_alerts
